Capacity is one of the few facts that genuinely changes what an evening will be like — a 200-person
room and a 3,000-person room are different products — and the venue page carries nothing about it.

**Decide what else the page should carry** at the same time, rather than adding one field now and
another next month.

The description itself is **done**: column, API, UI and hand-written seed blurbs all exist. Scraping
one per venue from its own website is part of the venue-enrichment issue, not this one.
